title: Security and runtime
description: Protections ship on by default. Change them here, from the CLI or the API; a saved value wins over the environment, which wins over the default.

empty.title: No runtime settings registered
empty.body: This build has nothing to configure here yet. Reload after updating the control plane.

readOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings. You can still see the current values.

buildNetwork.title: Build network
buildNetwork.description: Network for RUN steps of a build: open, none, or block-private (reserved: builds fail until it can be enforced). Read on every build.

placementScoreMode.title: Placement score mode
placementScoreMode.description: How new workloads pick a node: spread keeps the most headroom free on each node, binpack fills the fullest node that still fits. Read on every placement.

mcpDefaultTokenScope.title: Default token scope
mcpDefaultTokenScope.description: Scope for a new token created without explicit abilities: read_only or read_write. Existing tokens keep their scope.

lowFreeMb.title: Low disk threshold
lowFreeMb.description: Free space in MiB on the data or Docker volume below which the disk guard raises a low-disk warning and alert (64 to 1048576). Critical is clamped to this value when it is higher.

criticalFreeMb.title: Critical disk threshold
criticalFreeMb.description: Free space in MiB below which builds, image pulls and backups are refused and the disk reserve is released (16 to 1048576). A value above the low threshold is treated as equal to it.

reserveMb.title: Disk reserve size
reserveMb.description: Size in MiB of the placeholder file kept in the data dir so SQLite can still commit when the disk fills; it is released below the critical threshold (0 to 4096, 0 turns the reserve off).

metricsRetention.title: Raw metrics retention
metricsRetention.description: How long raw container metric samples are kept before the prune job deletes them, from 1h to 8760h; older data stays available in the coarser rollup tiers.

logsRetention.title: Log, trace and error retention
logsRetention.description: How long stored app logs, traces and error events are kept before the hourly sweep deletes them, from 1h to 8760h; the next sweep uses a changed value.

logBudgetMb.title: Default log budget per app
logBudgetMb.description: Stored log size in MiB each app may use before the sweep trims its oldest lines; 0 means unlimited, otherwise 16 to 10485760. A per-app budget overrides it.

rawRetention.title: Monitor raw result retention
rawRetention.description: How long each uptime monitor check result is kept before the prune job deletes it, from 1h to 8760h; hourly rollups are kept on their own window.

webhookReplayProtection.title: Webhook replay protection
webhookReplayProtection.description: Ignore a signed git webhook body that was already delivered within the replay window.

webhookReplayWindow.title: Webhook replay window
webhookReplayWindow.description: How long an identical signed webhook body is remembered.

auditSensitiveReads.title: Audit sensitive reads
auditSensitiveReads.description: Record an audit entry when logs, env exports and other sensitive data are read.

bindBlockCredentialDirs.title: Block credential directories in bind mounts
bindBlockCredentialDirs.description: Refuse bind mounts of .ssh, .aws, .kube and similar credential directories.

bindAllowedRoots.title: Allowed bind-mount roots
bindAllowedRoots.description: When not empty, bind mounts must sit inside one of these directories.

statusTimeout.title: Game status ping timeout
statusTimeout.description: How long the game server status ping waits for a game port to answer before reporting it offline. Values under 200ms are raised to 200ms.

statusCache.title: Game status cache time
statusCache.description: How long one game server status answer is reused, so many dashboards and CLI calls ping a game port at most once in this time. 0s turns the cache off.

trustLoopbackForwardedHeaders.title: Trust forwarded headers from loopback
trustLoopbackForwardedHeaders.description: Believe X-Forwarded-For when the request arrives from this host. Turn off when nothing local proxies to the control plane.

caSwitchRetryBase.title: CA switch retry delay
caSwitchRetryBase.description: First wait before retrying a certificate authority switch that failed to load; it doubles on each failure up to the maximum.

caSwitchRetryMax.title: CA switch maximum retry delay
caSwitchRetryMax.description: Upper bound on the wait between retries of a failed certificate authority switch.

sessionTtl.title: Desktop app session lifetime
sessionTtl.description: How long a dashboard session issued to the desktop app stays valid before it must exchange its token again.

revokedTokenDays.title: Delete revoked API tokens after
revokedTokenDays.description: Days a revoked API token stays listed before the cleanup removes it. 0 keeps them forever.

expiredTokenDays.title: Delete expired API tokens after
expiredTokenDays.description: Days an expired API token stays listed before the cleanup removes it. 0 keeps them forever.

jobMaxAttempts.title: Job ping attempts
jobMaxAttempts.description: How many times a per-job heartbeat ping is tried before it is given up.

jobBackoffBase.title: Job ping retry delay
jobBackoffBase.description: First wait before retrying a failed job ping; it doubles on each retry up to the maximum.

jobBackoffMax.title: Job ping maximum retry delay
jobBackoffMax.description: Upper bound on the wait between job ping retries.

jobQueue.title: Job ping queue size
jobQueue.description: How many job pings may wait to be sent before new ones are dropped. A change applies at once.

rateLimitReadRpm.title: API read rate limit
rateLimitReadRpm.description: Read requests per minute allowed for each API token, signed-in user or client address. Requests over the budget get HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Minimum 60 so the dashboard keeps working; a change applies at once and keeps each caller's current budget. A limit cannot be switched off: an environment value of 0 or below the minimum is raised to the minimum (older releases treated 0 as off).

rateLimitWriteRpm.title: API write rate limit
rateLimitWriteRpm.description: Write and deploy requests per minute allowed for each API token, signed-in user or client address. Requests over the budget get HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Minimum 20 so an operator cannot lock themselves out; a change applies at once. A limit cannot be switched off: an environment value of 0 or below the minimum is raised to the minimum (older releases treated 0 as off).

rateLimitRedeemRpm.title: Password reset and invite redeem rate limit
rateLimitRedeemRpm.description: Password reset and invite accept requests per minute allowed from one client address. Requests over the budget get HTTP 429. Minimum 3; a change applies at once. A limit cannot be switched off: an environment value of 0 or below the minimum is raised to the minimum (older releases treated 0 as off).

engineRateLimitPerIp.title: Sign-in rate limit per address
engineRateLimitPerIp.description: Credential requests (sign in, password reset, MFA) per minute allowed from one client address before it gets HTTP 429. This slows credential stuffing; it cannot be turned off and the minimum is 10 so an admin can still sign in. An environment value below 10 is raised to 10. Needs a restart because the auth library holds the budget.

engineRateLimitPerEmail.title: Sign-in rate limit per account
engineRateLimitPerEmail.description: Credential requests per minute allowed for one account name from any address before it gets HTTP 429. This slows targeted password guessing; it cannot be turned off and the minimum is 10 so the owner can still sign in. An environment value below 10 is raised to 10. Needs a restart because the auth library holds the budget.

maxBodyBytes.title: API request body limit
maxBodyBytes.description: Largest JSON request body in bytes the API reads before any handler runs; a bigger body is cut off and the request fails with HTTP 413. Source uploads, git pushes and asset uploads have their own limits. Between 1 MiB and 1 GiB; a change applies to the next request.

uploadMaxBytes.title: Asset upload size limit
uploadMaxBytes.description: Largest single asset object in bytes accepted by a direct or presigned upload; a bigger upload is refused with HTTP 413. Between 1 MiB and 1 TiB; direct uploads are exempt from the API request body limit and obey only this one. A change applies to the next upload.

maxConcurrent.title: Concurrent deploys
maxConcurrent.description: How many deploys may run at once across all apps; extra deploys wait in the queue and start when one finishes. 0 means no limit. A change applies to the next queue decision.

dependsOnTimeout.title: Compose dependency wait
dependsOnTimeout.description: How long a compose service waits for a depends_on dependency to start, pass its health check or exit 0 before the deploy fails naming that dependency, from 5s to 1h; a change applies on the next reconcile pass.

interval.title: Cleanup interval
interval.description: How often the scheduled cleanup checks every data type. The minimum is 15 minutes.

enabled.title: Run cleanup on a schedule
enabled.description: Turn the scheduled cleanup off entirely. Manual cleanups still work.

memoryLimitMb.title: Build memory limit
memoryLimitMb.description: Memory in MiB one build may use (256 to 1048576). 0 means auto: 60 percent of the host memory, at least 512 and always leaving a reserve for the control plane (APP_BUILD_MEMORY_PERCENT and APP_BUILD_MEMORY_RESERVE_MB tune the formula). The cap also limits swap, and Node builds get a matching --max-old-space-size. A change applies to the next build; running builds keep their limit. A saved per-app or global value from build limits still wins.

auditLogDays.title: Keep audit log entries for
auditLogDays.description: Days an audit log entry is kept before the cleanup removes it. Sign-in and policy entries follow their own, longer window. 0 keeps everything.

auditSecurityDays.title: Keep security audit entries for
auditSecurityDays.description: Days sign-in, step-up, token and policy audit entries are kept. Never shorter than the general window. 0 keeps them forever.

emailLogDays.title: Keep the email delivery log for
emailLogDays.description: Days an email delivery log row is kept. 0 keeps them forever.

webhookDeliveryDays.title: Keep inbound webhook deliveries for
webhookDeliveryDays.description: Days a received git webhook delivery is kept for troubleshooting. 0 keeps them forever.

eventWebhookDays.title: Keep event webhook deliveries for
eventWebhookDays.description: Days a finished outbound event webhook delivery is kept. 0 keeps them forever.

alertHistoryDays.title: Keep alert history for
alertHistoryDays.description: Days an alert history entry is kept. 0 keeps them forever.

containersRestartPolicy.title: Container restart policy
containersRestartPolicy.description: Docker restart policy for long-running app containers, so apps come back after a host reboot or Docker restart. Applies to containers created on the next deploy or recreate; existing containers keep their old policy.

backupLocalRoot.title: Local backup root
backupLocalRoot.description: Absolute directory on the control plane that confines local backup targets. Empty uses backups/ under the data directory. The next backup or restore uses a changed value; target paths stay relative to it and cannot leave it.

outboundTimeout.title: Outbound request timeout
outboundTimeout.description: How long an outbound HTTP request from the control plane (cloud metadata, model probes, upgrade checks) may take before it is cancelled. The next request uses a changed value.

bootRechecks.title: Boot recheck delays
bootRechecks.description: Offsets after start, colon separated (for example 3s:10s), at which the control plane runs extra reconcile passes so routes are fixed when Docker publishes ports late after a host reboot. Each offset is at least 1s. Read at start.

bootEventRecheck.title: Boot recheck after first event
bootEventRecheck.description: How long after the first Docker event the control plane runs one more reconcile pass, from 1s to 1h. Read at start.

metricsScrapeEnabled.title: Prometheus scrape endpoint
metricsScrapeEnabled.description: Serve app, database and node metrics in Prometheus text format at /metrics for a read token. When off, the endpoint answers 404.

envApplyOnSet.title: Apply env changes on set
envApplyOnSet.description: When on, env set and env import restart the app so the new values reach the running container, as if --apply was passed. Pass --no-apply to keep one change pending. Off by default; a change applies to the next command.

maxReplicasPerService.title: Replica cap per service
maxReplicasPerService.description: Largest replica count the API accepts for one service when an app is created, updated or scaled; a bigger count is refused with HTTP 400. Between 1 and 1000; a change applies to the next request, running apps keep their count.

containersInspectTimeout.title: Container inspect timeout
containersInspectTimeout.description: How long the app containers view waits for a node's live inspect (health, restarts, networks, mounts), from 1s to 2m. When it runs out the view still answers, with those fields marked unavailable. The next request uses a changed value.

restart.title_one: A restart is needed to apply {{count}} change
restart.title_other: A restart is needed to apply {{count}} changes
restart.body: Saved values for restart settings take effect the next time the control plane starts. Running apps keep serving.
restart.confirmBody: The dashboard and API are unavailable for a short moment. Running apps keep serving traffic.
restart.unsupported: This install cannot restart itself. Restart the control plane process yourself, then check again.

confirm.title: Lower this protection?
confirm.body: {{title}} protects this install. Changing it is recorded in the audit log with your name.
confirm.consequence: Anything that relied on it is exposed until you turn it back on.

onboarding.title: Review your security defaults
onboarding.intro: These protections are on by default. Leave them as they are, or change any of them now. You can revisit them later in Settings.

overview.title: Data retention
overview.intro: How long each kind of history is kept. Token windows change here and in Settings, API tokens; the rest are set by environment variable or by their own page.

toolbar.noMatchBody: Try a shorter search, or clear the filters to see every setting.

prometheus.title: Prometheus scrape
prometheus.description: Create a read-only token and point Prometheus at /metrics.
prometheus.tokenOnce: Copy this token now. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
